Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar, the learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Ankita Tripathi, the learned AGA for the State and perused the records.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
645 of 2022, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506, 109 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 02.07.2022 against eight persons, including the applicant, alleging that the informant had made some investments in STS/Sankalp Group but upon maturity his amount was not repaid.
The applicant has been implicated in the present case subsequently, as she is also a Director of the body in which the investment was made.
No specific role has been levelled against her.

4. The applicant's involvement in total 42 other cases has been disclosed in the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, all of which are of similar nature, in five of which the applicant has Mithlesh Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139116418/
1 already been granted bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused Gunjan Verma, has been granted bail by means of order dated 18.08.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 11204 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 11204 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has already been granted bail in five other cases of similar nature and one of the co-accused persons has already been granted bail and that the applicant is languishing in jail since 24.11.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case also.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
